Businesses for sale in Cloverdale, with or without the real estate, listed on the MLS®. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

items.t: Buying a Surrey business: the City licence does not simply carry over. A change of owner costs $25 and needs a copy of the purchase and sale agreement, and the City may ask for more, such as health permits. ([City of Surrey, updating your business licence](https://www.surrey.ca/business-economy/business-licensing/updating-your-business-licence), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: What to ask for before you buy a business

items.t: Business only or with the property: many MLS® business listings sell the business and its lease, not the building. The listing says which.
The lease: its remaining term, renewal options and whether the landlord must approve an assignment to you.
The numbers: at least two or three years of financial statements and tax returns, and what is included (equipment, stock, name, website, phone number).
Licences and permits: the municipal business licence and any provincial licence the business needs, and whether they transfer.
Staff and suppliers: who stays, and which contracts carry over.
